title: Best Friends for Life seeks bakers for Nov. 22 bake sale to help Laredo's cats
excerpt: Best Friends for Life is asking home bakers and local businesses to donate baked goods for its bake sale on Sunday, Nov. 22, from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Puppy Palace, 517 Shiloh Drive, Suite 2 — with drop-offs Friday, Nov. 21.
content:
Best Friends for Life is looking for bakers. The feline-focused nonprofit, led by director Sandra Solis, is asking home bakers and local businesses to donate baked goods for its bake sale on Sunday, Nov. 22, from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Puppy Palace, 517 Shiloh Drive, Suite 2, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The group is seeking pies, muffins, bars and specialty pastries, along with the banana bread, brownies, cookies and full cakes offered last year. Donors can bake items themselves or buy baked goods to contribute. Donated goods can be dropped off Friday, Nov. 21, at the same location.

Last year's sale raised $2,800 from home bakers and small businesses, and this year's goal is to surpass that amount. The money supports the nonprofit's care for homeless and abandoned cats in Laredo. The sale is held at a pet supply store because it draws people who already care for animals.

To donate or ask about the sale, email bestfriendsforlife15@yahoo.com or call 956-286-2375.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 11, 2026; lmtonline.com.
